writing-invented-in-mesopotamia: Sumerian scribes in cities such as Uruk start pressing cuneiform signs into clay tablets, first to keep accounts.
black-death: Plague spreads from Central Asia along trade routes and kills perhaps a third to half of Europe's population.
eighty-years-war: The Dutch provinces revolt against Habsburg Spain, starting with the Battle of Heiligerlee. Independence is recognised 80 years later.
jenners-smallpox-vaccine: Edward Jenner protects a boy against smallpox with cowpox — the first vaccine.
kaiser-wilhelm-ii-flees-to-the-netherlan: Germany's last emperor crosses the border at Eijsden and is granted asylum. The Netherlands refuses Allied demands to hand him over; he lives at Huis Doorn until his death in 1941.
north-sea-flood: A storm surge breaks the dikes in Zeeland and South Holland, killing 1,836 people in the Netherlands.
great-leap-forward: Mao's push to industrialise overnight leads to a famine in which tens of millions die.
covid-19-pandemic: The WHO declares a pandemic on 11 March 2020 and ends the global health emergency on 5 May 2023.
